about_the_game:
🎵 Official Soundtrack — Siren's Well 🎵


Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere of Siren's Well with this Official Soundtrack, featuring a collection of chilling and emotional tracks that bring the terror and tragedy of Broken Paradise Asylum to life.

From whispering melodies to pulse-pounding dread, each composition was crafted to reflect the psychological torment, eerie beauty, and twisted memories experienced by Scarlett Lee Monroe and Ravenna Tsuki as they descend deeper into the cursed asylum.

🩸 Features

• Over 128 original tracks composed exclusively for the game
• Includes bonus tracks and alternate versions not found in the main game
• Perfect for writing, relaxing (if you dare), or revisiting the nightmare

📍 About the Music


Every piece is a reflection of the game’s duality — the silence of sorrow and the scream of fear. Whether you’re standing alone in the dark halls or running for your life, this soundtrack ensures that the horrors of Siren’s Well will echo long after the game ends.

🕯️ Warning


This music contains unsettling tones, static interference, reversed whispers, and ambient dread. Listener discretion is advised.

Do you hear it...? The Siren’s song never fades.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may not be suitable for all audiences. It features intense violence, optional nudity in all unlockable outfits, suggestive erotic themes, and depictions of legal drug use. The unsettling atmosphere and adult content are designed to heighten the horror experience. Proceed with caution.
